file_roles.evidence: Directory(params.fs_checkpoint_dir,...) created only one dir from the comma-joined string; now loops over params.fs_checkpoint_dirs.
fs_checkpoint_dir = config[...] used raw comma string; now .split(',') into fs_checkpoint_dirs, the list the script consumes.

rationale: The report says only the first of several comma-separated checkpoint dirs gets created, so SecondaryNameNode fails with a missing dir. params.py produced a single string and hdfs_snamenode.py consumed it as one path; both lines were wrong and both changed. The logged exception comes from Hadoop's SecondaryNameNode, outside the repo.
